messages:
maria: FYI CI perf-suite started failing on main after the Triton/PyTorch bump landed in #4582. p99 token latency ~2.1x on long-context runs. rolling canary flagged by deploy-bot.
ci-bot: perf-suite failure summary: job=perf/suite/long-context, baseline=2026-03-10T08:12:00Z, current=2026-03-17T09:32:10Z, p99 increase +110% (regression threshold 20%). link: https://ci.internal/perf/1234
ajay: I started a local bisect across merges since the bump. Quick timeline: PyTorch 2.2.1 -> Triton 2.0.5 -> libcublas 12.1.* change. Suspect kernel algo selection shifted for matmul + attention kernels.
lina: Posted a pprof diff from the failing run vs baseline: top stacks show 40% more time in matmul_kernel_impl and a new path in triton::algo::choose that wasn't hot before.
ryan: nvidia-smi on the failing canary: Driver 535.54.03, CUDA 12.1, GPUs: A100-SXM4 80GB. Baseline (last-green) had Driver 535.35.01. Small driver subpatch.
devon: Can we get the exact commit that flipped behavior? ajay, does bisect point to a specific PR?
ajay: Bisect points to merge 0d3f7c3 which upgraded Triton -> 2.0.5 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/triton-wrapper/pull/412). Reverting that commit locally makes the regression disappear.
maria: Is 412 the PR that also pulled in a cuBLAS algorithm table change? I remember a change that enabled heuristics for FP16 matmul.
ajay: Yes, PR 412 enables autotune/heuristic fallback for certain shapes. It seems the new heuristic picks a slower algo for our long kv/dense dims.
lina: I attached a flamegraph snippet (reduced):
```
+ matmul_kernel_impl  42%
  + triton::algo::choose  18%
  + cudaLaunchKernel  12%
```
simon: Quick mitigation: we can force the previous kernel path by setting TRITON_MATMUL_ALGO_OVERRIDE=legacy in the serving runtime config. That avoids a full revert while we investigate.
ryan: Also noticed KV cache behavior changed: more memcpy time on cache refill paths after the bump. Maybe a change in kernel launch batching interacts with KV placement.
devon: We need to decide: revert PR 412 in main to unblock canary+prod, or roll our own small patch to pin algorithm selection. Opinions?
maria: Rollout is blocked right now by the canary SLOs. I prefer a fast revert to restore baseline and then reintroduce with tests.
sre-bot: Canary auto-rollback is disabled for this cluster; manual rollback required. Current state: canary=paused, traffic=10%, rollout blocked.
ajay: I opened a revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/triton-wrapper/pull/419 — reverts 412. Runs full perf-suite in CI.
ci-bot: PR 419: perf-suite (long-context) started. Early results look like p99 restored to baseline on the first run.
lina: Parallel investigation notes: profiling suggests the triangle inequality in the new heuristic incorrectly estimates workspace needed for certain shapes, causing fallback into a conservative (but slower) algo. We need shape-specific autotune records.
simon: Long-term fix: add a reproducible autotune step in our CI that runs representative shapes (kv lengths, batch sizes) and records algorithm picks, store as lockfile.
devon: Agree. For now, let's merge the revert, unpause canary, and then add a gated autotune PR that adds tests. Who can own the autotune lockfile work?
ajay: I'll take the autotune harness and a small change to accept a lockfile generated on CI. Will sync with eng-ml on shapes.
maria: Thanks. Action items: 1) devon merge PR 419 revert (if CI green) 2) ajay start autotune harness PR 3) lina continue profiling to produce minimal repro and send perf counters (cuBLAS API calls, workspace sizes). I'll follow up in a doc.
devon: Merged PR 419 at 1762104802, canary unpaused at 1762104920, monitoring.
maria: Canary metrics back to baseline. Marking this a rollout blocker resolved. We'll keep the issue open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/678 for follow-up autotune + tests. :white_check_mark:
